text: {"lessons":["My account has stayed near $100,000 through modest month-to-month changes, so I should avoid reacting hastily to short-term moves.","Selling Stock A and Stock E below my average cost and Stock B above it reminds me not to let my purchase price alone determine whether I hold or sell.","Because these savings support my retirement, I should favor a cautious, deliberate approach and trade only when it fits my need to limit large swings."]}
